title: Find Cumulative Salary of an Employee
goal: Solve Find Cumulative Salary of an Employee: Calculate the cumulative salary for each employee per month, showing the running total across the year.
strategy: Calculate the cumulative salary for each employee per month, showing the running total across the year.
edgeCases: A rolling salary window is defined by months, not merely the previous fixed number of stored rows when months are absent.
inputRules: Must be an array of employees
Each employee must have id, month, and salary as numbers
